# Contributing

Thanks for your interest! Bug reports, feature ideas and pull requests are
welcome in all steitec projects.

By taking part you agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Reporting bugs and asking for features

Open an issue in the project's repository and pick a template. Please include
the version you use, your environment and the steps to reproduce the problem.

Security problems do not belong in public issues; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Development setup and tests

Each project's README describes how to install it for development and how to
run its tests. The CI workflow in `.github/workflows/` runs the same commands;
if something works locally but fails there, that file is the reference.

## Pull requests

1. Fork the repository and create a branch from `main`.
2. Keep the change focused; one topic per pull request.
3. Add or update tests for new behaviour and bug fixes.
4. Update the README and the `CHANGELOG.md` (an `## Unreleased` section at the
   top), if the project has one, when users will notice the change.
5. Make sure all tests pass, then open the pull request and fill in the
   template.

Style: follow the surrounding code and keep dependencies to a minimum.
